# 929. Unique Email Addresses

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def numUniqueEmails(self, emails):
        """
        :type emails: List[str]
        :rtype: int
        """
        emails_set = set()
        for email in emails:
            i = email.index('@')
            emails_set.add(email[:i].split("+", 1)[0].replace(".", "") + email[i:])
        return len(emails_set)
```
